description: (0.5.0, Draft) Chunk assembly, completion, supersede on re-emission in the same task, and derived_from on continuation in a new task (RFC-ACDP-0022 §4.2–§4.3).

input.note: Run the agent against a test registry, with a client that sends the a2a-001 task (two chunks for artifactId fraud-summary) unless a scenario says otherwise.

scenarios.name: A — one body per completed artifact

expected.behavior: Two chunks (append false, then append true with lastChunk true) produce exactly one body, published after the second chunk is assembled; its parts_hash covers both chunks' parts in order. No body is published per chunk or per Task.

An artifact streamed without lastChunk true, or only returned in a Task snapshot, is published once when the task enters TASK_STATE_COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED or REJECTED; INPUT_REQUIRED and AUTH_REQUIRED complete nothing. The link appears in the snapshot only.

After completion, an append:false chunk for the same artifactId in the same task, completed again, publishes version 2 with supersedes = the version-1 ctx_id, the same agent_id and registry, a fresh salt and parts_hash over the replacement parts. The feed shows an ordinary superseded change.
Further append:true chunks after completion, completed again, publish a new version whose parts_hash covers all parts as now assembled, not only the new chunks.
If the version-1 publish failed (fail-open), the re-completion publishes version 1, not a supersession. A registry already_superseded rejection is a publish failure (§6.2).

scenarios.name: F — continuation in a new task

expected.behavior: A later task that revises the artifact (its message lists the earlier task in referenceTaskIds) publishes a new version-1 body whose derived_from lists the earlier body's ctx_id first, before cited inputs. It never supersedes across tasks.
Every later Task.artifacts snapshot carries the same assembled parts for the key, so a holder of the snapshot recomputes the same parts_hash.
An artifact relayed unchanged from another agent, or (under an A2A revision with Artifact.role) a ROLE_USER artifact, produces no body.
